set(external_folder "ThirdParty")
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

if(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
    set(TRACY_ENABLE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(TRACY_STATIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(TRACY_ON_DEMAND ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(tracy EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    set_target_properties(TracyClient PROPERTIES
        FOLDER "${external_folder}/tracy"
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${BINARY_ROOT_DIR}"
        LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${BINARY_ROOT_DIR}"
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${BINARY_ROOT_DIR}"
        RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${BINARY_ROOT_DIR}"
        LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${BINARY_ROOT_DIR}"
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${BINARY_ROOT_DIR}"
    )
endif()

if (NOT TARGET spdlog)
    option(SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE "" OFF)
    option(SPDLOG_INSTALL "" OFF)
    add_subdirectory(spdlog)
    set_target_properties(spdlog PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/spdlog)
endif ()

if (NOT TARGET glad)
    include(glad.cmake)
    set_target_properties(glad PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/glad)
endif ()

if (NOT TARGET glfw)
    option(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES "" OFF)
    option(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS "" OFF)
    option(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS "" OFF)
    option(GLFW_INSTALL "" OFF)
    add_subdirectory(glfw)
    set_target_properties(glfw PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/glfw)
    if(TARGET update_mappings)
        set_target_properties(update_mappings PROPERTIES FOLDER "${external_folder}/glfw")
    endif()
endif ()

if (NOT TARGET imgui)
    include(imgui.cmake)
    set_target_properties(imgui PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/imgui)
endif ()

if (NOT TARGET EnTT::EnTT)
    option(ENTT_BUILD_TEST "" OFF)
    option(ENTT_BUILD_DOCS "" OFF)
    option(ENTT_INSTALL "" OFF)
    add_subdirectory(entt)

    get_target_property(ENTT_ACTUAL_TARGET EnTT::EnTT ALIASED_TARGET)
    if (ENTT_ACTUAL_TARGET)
        set_target_properties(${ENTT_ACTUAL_TARGET} PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/entt)
    endif ()
endif ()

if (NOT TARGET stb_image)
    include(stb_image.cmake)
    set_target_properties(stb_image PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/stb_image)
endif ()

if (NOT TARGET glm)
    option(GLM_BUILD_TEST "" OFF)
    option(GLM_BUILD_DOC "" OFF)
    option(GLM_BUILD_INSTALL "" OFF)
    add_subdirectory(glm)
    set_target_properties(glm PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/glm)
endif ()

if (NOT TARGET box2d)
    option(BOX2D_BUILD_TEST "" OFF)
    option(BOX2D_BUILD_DOC "" OFF)
    option(BOX2D_BUILD_INSTALL "" OFF)
    add_subdirectory(box2d)
    set_target_properties(box2d PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/box2d)
endif()

if(NOT TARGET Jolt)
    option(INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION "" OFF)
    option(ENABLE_ALL_WARNINGS "" OFF)
    option(ENABLE_INSTALL "" OFF)
    option(FLOATING_POINT_EXCEPTIONS_ENABLED "" OFF)
    option(USE_STATIC_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "" OFF)
    option(JPH_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "" OFF)
    option(JPH_USE_DX12 "" OFF)
    option(JPH_USE_VK "" OFF)
    option(JPH_USE_MTL "" OFF)
    option(JPH_USE_CPU_COMPUTE "" OFF)
    add_subdirectory(JoltPhysics/Build)
    set_target_properties(Jolt PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/jolt)
endif()

if (NOT TARGET json)
    option(JSON_BUILD_TEST "" OFF)
    option(JSON_BUILD_DOC "" OFF)
    option(JSON_BUILD_INSTALL "" OFF)
    add_subdirectory(json)

    if (TARGET nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
        get_target_property(JSON_ACTUAL_TARGET nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json ALIASED_TARGET)
        if (JSON_ACTUAL_TARGET)
            set_target_properties(${JSON_ACTUAL_TARGET} PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/json)
        endif ()
    elseif (TARGET nlohmann_json)
        set_target_properties(nlohmann_json PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/json)
    endif ()
endif()

if(NOT TARGET nethost::nethost)
    include(nethost.cmake)
endif()

if(NOT TARGET mimalloc::mimalloc)
    include(mimalloc.cmake)
    set_target_properties(mimalloc-static PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/mimalloc)
endif()

if(NOT TARGET Microsoft::DirectX-Headers)
    add_subdirectory(DirectX-Headers ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/DirectX-Headers)
endif()

if(TARGET DirectX-Headers)
    set_target_properties(DirectX-Headers PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/DirectX-Headers)
endif()
if(TARGET DirectX-Guids)
    set_target_properties(DirectX-Guids PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/DirectX-Headers)
endif()
foreach(_ctest_target IN ITEMS Continuous Experimental Nightly NightlyMemoryCheck)
    if(TARGET ${_ctest_target})
        set_target_properties(${_ctest_target} PROPERTIES FOLDER "${external_folder}/DirectX-Headers")
    endif()
endforeach()

if(NOT TARGET assimp)
    include(assimp.cmake)
    set_target_properties(assimp PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/assimp)
    if(TARGET zlibstatic)
        set_target_properties(zlibstatic PROPERTIES FOLDER "${external_folder}/assimp")
    endif()
    if(TARGET UpdateAssimpLibsDebugSymbolsAndDLLs)
        set_target_properties(UpdateAssimpLibsDebugSymbolsAndDLLs PROPERTIES FOLDER "${external_folder}/assimp")
    endif()
endif()

if(DODOE_EDITOR AND NOT TARGET ads::qtadvanceddocking-qt6)
    include(qt-ads.cmake)
endif()

if(NOT TARGET Vulkan::Headers)
    if(TARGET Vulkan::Vulkan)
        get_target_property(_vk_inc_dirs Vulkan::Vulkan INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
        add_library(Vulkan::Headers INTERFACE IMPORTED)
        set_target_properties(Vulkan::Headers PROPERTIES INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${_vk_inc_dirs}")
    else()
        find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED)
        add_library(Vulkan::Headers INTERFACE IMPORTED)
        set_target_properties(Vulkan::Headers PROPERTIES INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${Vulkan_INCLUDE_DIRS}")
    endif()
endif()

if(NOT TARGET spirv-cross-core)
    include(spirv-cross.cmake)
endif()

if(NOT TARGET audio)
    include(audio.cmake)
    set_target_properties(audio PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/audio)
endif()

if(NOT TARGET cutie)
    include(cutie-rhi.cmake)
    set_target_properties(cutie PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/cutie-rhi)
    if(TARGET cutie_vk)
        set_target_properties(cutie_vk PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/cutie-rhi)
    endif()
    if(TARGET cutie_gl)
        set_target_properties(cutie_gl PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/cutie-rhi)
    endif()
    if(TARGET cutie_d3d12)
        set_target_properties(cutie_d3d12 PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/cutie-rhi)
    endif()
endif()

option(DODOE_PYTHON_ENABLED "Enable Python scripting support (pybind11)" OFF)

if(DODOE_PYTHON_ENABLED)
    if(NOT TARGET pybind11::pybind11)
        set(Python_ROOT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/python")
        if(NOT Python_FOUND AND NOT Python3_FOUND)
            find_package(Python 3.8 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter Development)
        endif()
        add_subdirectory(pybind11)
        set_target_properties(pybind11_headers PROPERTIES FOLDER ${external_folder}/pybind11)

        file(GLOB PYTHON_DLL "${Python_ROOT_DIR}/python3*.dll")
        add_custom_target(DodoePythonRuntimeFiles ALL
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                ${PYTHON_DLL}
                "${BINARY_ROOT_DIR}/"
            COMMENT "Copying python3*.dll to output directory"
        )
        set_target_properties(DodoePythonRuntimeFiles PROPERTIES FOLDER "Engine/Resources")
    endif()
endif()
